Serilog._comment: This host logs via Serilog (ReadFrom.Configuration), NOT the default 'Logging' provider. NOTE: SerilogExtensions.cs hardcodes MinimumLevel in C# AFTER reading this section (non-Development => Information), so the effective floor is Information regardless of the value below; the Override entries here still apply. Adjust SerilogExtensions.cs if you need a different production floor.

Cors._comment: Production origins allowed by 'YallaJoPolicy' (AllowCredentials for SignalR + Web frontend). Replace with the real deployed Web host origin(s). Wildcards are illegal with credentials.

Booking._comment: Force real DB-backed cross-module snapshot readers in Production (never the Development stub fallback), even if the environment name is ever misconfigured.

ExternalAuth._comment: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret with the Web BFF (same SigningKey on both sides). Supply via environment variables / key vault in production (ExternalAuth__SigningKey) — at least 32 bytes. Do NOT ship the dev key to production.

Recaptcha._comment: reCAPTCHA v3. SecretKey is server-only — supply via environment variables (Recaptcha__SecretKey). BypassForTesting MUST be false in production.

OpenTelemetry._comment: Set the OTLP collector endpoint for production traces/metrics (OpenTelemetry__OtlpEndpoint). Empty => exporter disabled.

Retention._comment: Auth disposable-state cleanup runs on the API host (single host). Keep Enabled=true here.

Weather._comment: WeatherAPI.com provider. To enable in production, set Provider='weatherapi' and supply ApiKey via environment variables (Weather__Provider, Weather__ApiKey). Defaults target the Free plan (100,000 calls/month, 3-day forecast cap).

ContentBlogs._comment: HMAC-SHA256 key for content_blogs.BlogViews.ViewerHash. REQUIRED: the application refuses to start if missing/whitespace. Supply via environment variables / key vault (ContentBlogs__ViewerHashSecret).
